utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time should I come by on Saturday, and what kind of help do you need?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Come by around 10 a.m. on the front porch, and I could use help greeting folks, setting out tools, and keeping the parts sorted.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m still lining up helpers for the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch, so if you know anyone who can lend a hand, I’d really appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, I can help out on Saturday at the front porch. I’ll ask around too and see who else might be free.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’ll be this Saturday at 10 a.m. on the front porch, and folks should bring basic hand tools if they have them.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can ask around, but I’m a little worried about parking and where people can set their tools down. Do you want me to help line up a table or just spread the word?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m still putting together the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch, and I could use a few helpers.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still lining up helpers for the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’m still lining up a few more helpers for the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch, so if you know anyone handy, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, that repair drive. I can help out on Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, that helps a lot. I’m still lining up a few more helpers for the repair drive this Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. I appreciate you helping line people up for Saturday on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can ask around for anyone handy, but I need the exact time and what tools they should bring.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Pia. It starts at 10 a.m., and they should bring a basic tool kit if they have one.
